description: Owner 2026-11-28: warlock 1-9 too easy since the imp keeps the approach turn; the imp of a warlock in the training kit (levels 1-14) deals a third of its damage (sim_early: two enemies cost 8-20% HP, now about 30-55%). Companions and warlocks from 15 unchanged.

edits.name: Training shape: the warlock's imp deals a third of its damage while the warlock is in the training kit (1-14)
apply the training pet multiplier
edits.old: c.specs[sk], lvlFactor(p.level || lvl), aura), ps = c.specs[sk].passives, o = st.heroes[i];
edits.new: c.specs[sk], lvlFactor(p.level || lvl), aura), ps = c.specs[sk].passives, o = st.heroes[i]; if (pet && o.neutralTraining && (TRAINING_SHAPE[p.cls] || {}).pet) pet.atk *= TRAINING_SHAPE[p.cls].pet; /* owner 2026-11-28 (BAL-04/05): warlock 1-14 lost only 8-20% HP against two enemies */
